items:
30A Escapes presents…"Dune Our Thing", a stunning beach cottage located in the authentic “Old Florida” community of Inlet Beach, surrounded by 13 acres of protected dunes. Located just a 1-minute stroll from pristine sandy shores, this elegantly crafted home boasts a private rooftop terrace with stunning Gulf Views, a fenced backyard with a gas grill, and access to a nearby community pool. Ideal for family vacations or group retreats. Learn more below... 👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Steps to the Beach: Located only a minute’s walk from the turquoise waters and white sand
✔ Rooftop Terrace: Spacious veranda with loungers, flat-screen TV, and seating for alfresco dining
✔ Private Backyard: Fully fenced-in space with a gas grill for evening barbecues
✔ Beautiful Design: Classic shiplap finishes, quartz countertops, and rustic pine flooring throughout
✔ Family Friendly: Sleeps up to 10 guests with plenty of room to relax and unwind
✔ Community Perks: Enjoy access to the private pool and nearby scenic bike trail to Rosemary Beach
✔ Beach Bikes: Includes 6 bikes for guests to explore 30A and its surrounding areas

Eager to Read More?

Here Are A Few Kind Words from Our Previous Guests:

⭐ "We had a great time at this Inlet Beach house. The views from the third floor terrace are incredible and we spent most of our time there. The beach access is super close and the pool is just steps away. Looking forward to returning next year." – Dana S.
⭐ "Great location and easy access to the beach with 3 kids! We had 8 people and could’ve had more comfortably. 10 out of 10!" – Michalene B.
⭐ "Pictures matched the high quality of this property. Exceptional customer service from the property management company. Highly recommend." – Tom L.

★☆ LIVING AREAS ☆★

"Dune Our Thing" offers bright, open living spaces that perfectly balance comfort and style. The ground floor features an airy layout, ideal for unwinding after a day at the beach. Classic shiplap walls, rustic wood accents, and pine flooring lend a timeless coastal charm to the space.
Relax in plush seating by the cozy gas fireplace, surrounded by warm tones that set the stage for evening gatherings or movie nights. Meanwhile, the third floor boasts an additional living area adorned with coastal decor and equipped with a Smart TV—an ideal retreat for kids and teens seeking their own space.

✔ Gorgeous open-plan design with coastal decor
✔ Premium seating, gas fireplace, and smart flat-screen TV
✔ Seamless flow into the kitchen and dining area
✔ 3rd floor living room with plush sofa and smart TV

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

Designed for foodies and families alike, the chef-inspired kitchen is equipped with modern quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a large island. Whether you're cooking up a fresh seafood feast or enjoying takeout from nearby restaurants, the dining experience here is unparalleled.

✔ Fully equipped chef’s kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances
✔ Large dining table for 6 coupled with breakfast bar seating 4
✔ Convenient access to the backyard grill for easy outdoor dining

★☆ OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ☆★

Relaxation continues outdoors with spaces that invite lounging and entertaining. The fenced backyard provides privacy for barbecues, while the rooftop terrace is the ultimate spot to enjoy sunsets with your favorite drink in hand.

✔ Rooftop terrace with loungers, flat-screen TV, dining area for 6, and Gulf Views for days
✔ Gas grill in the fenced backyard for hosting meals alfresco
✔ Community pool located steps from the home

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

Spanning across multiple levels, each room in the home is thoughtfully designed to ensure your group’s comfort. Luxurious bedding, en-suite bathrooms, and smart TVs make every bedroom a private sanctuary.

1st Floor:
✔ Half bathroom for guest’s convenience

2nd Floor:
✔ Primary Suite 1: King-size bed, en-suite bath with walk-in shower and double vanity
✔ Guest Suite 2: King-size bed, en-suite bath with shower/tub combo, and Smart TV

3rd Floor:
✔ Bedroom 3: King-size bed, coastal touches, and airy natural light
✔ Bedroom 4: Queen-over-queen bunk bed, ideal for families and extra guests
✔ Shared Full Bathroom: Shower/tub combination for 3rd-floor guests

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Discover the serenity of Inlet Beach, a picturesque coastal haven exuding Old Florida charm. Nestled near 13+ acres of pristine, protected dunes, it’s a dream destination for outdoor enthusiasts. Just steps from the Gulf's sparkling waters and neighboring the vibrant community of Rosemary Beach, this location offers both tranquility and convenience.

✔ Orange Street Beach Access: A 1-minute walk to regional handicap-accessible beach access with seasonal lifeguards and one of the area's four artificial reefs, located just 970 feet offshore.
✔ Rosemary Beach: Only 0.8 miles away, featuring boutique shopping, fine dining, and live music.
✔ Camp Helen State Park: A 2-mile trip to explore Powell Lake, a rare coastal dune lake, plus hiking trails, fishing docks, paddleboard rentals, and the historic lodge—a romantic wedding venue.
✔ 30 Avenue and Shoppes at Inlet: Just 1 mile away, enjoy boutique shopping, gourmet dining, fitness studios, spas, and seasonal live music and nightlife.



★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 6 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.
✔ Construction is currently underway next to the property.
✔ To see a virtual tour of this home, please visit https://www.insidemaps.com/app/walkthrough-v2/?projectId=T9YAMGYyaB&env=production

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★
